title: Agile Reflection

rubric.criterion: Agile values and principles applied correctly in context
Scrum - pros/cons of practice in a university environment
Kanban, XP or other - considered, with reasoning
Reflection on previous development experience + Agile counterfactual
rubric.note: Largest single block. Requires a real past experience, its actual outcome, and how Agile would have changed it.

rubric.criterion: Writing style - structure, flow, grammar, formatting, use of word limit

named_traps: Reading as a series of general pros and cons - the brief threatens a REDO for this
Using ChatGPT for content (reversal from A1, which encouraged it and gave 2 marks for declaring it)
Merely repeating definitions of Agile and Scrum
Exceeding 900 words (penalties apply) or writing noticeably short
gen_ai_policy: Should not be used for creating content, because it cannot reflect on your behalf. A declaration section still exists if used. OPPOSITE of A1.
open_questions: From L4: whether the 'one other practice' must be Kanban/XP specifically. The brief says 'Kanban, Extreme Programming (XP), or other principles', so a named justified alternative should qualify - not confirmed by the lecturer.
Rubric weightings for the three A2 criteria were never stated aloud in L4; they are taken from the PDF.
next_action: Draft against the Gibbs Analysis spine. Put ~300 of 850 words on the past-experience-plus-counterfactual block; it carries 3 of 8 content marks. Submit via Canvas A2 Quiz before 9pm 2026-08-07.
